literal: Other than saying 'This woman became pale', those who say 'He is the one who abandoned her' are none.
translation: Except for pointing out, 'This woman has turned pale,' there is no one who says, 'He is the one who abandoned her.'
modern: இவள் உடல் பசலை நிறமடைந்துவிட்டாள் என்று சொல்வதைத் தவிர, அவளை விட்டுப் பிரிந்து சென்றவர் அவர்தான் என்று சொல்பவர் யாரும் இல்லை.
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine laments the unfairness of public gossip. People around her easily notice her physical change and remark that she has turned pale with grief. However, they fail to point out or blame the lover who departed and caused her this pain. The verse highlights her loneliness, as the world judges her visible suffering without holding the responsible partner accountable.
